data.name: Agent name
data.max_tokens: Maximum tokens to return in response
data.context_truncate_strategy: Context truncation strategy when exceeded threshold

data_description.web_search: Allow the model to use OpenAI's native Web Search tool for current or external information. Requires the direct OpenAI Responses API.
data_description.web_search_context: Controls retrieval breadth only when Web Search is enabled. Low is recommended for concise voice-agent answers.
data_description.memory_mode: Off disables persistent memory. Manual saves only explicit remember requests. Automatic may proactively save stable, useful facts under the existing safety rules.
data_description.knowledge_enabled: Allow on-demand search and retrieval of this agent's locally stored Knowledge sources.
data_description.archive_enabled: Store user messages and final assistant replies locally. Disabled by default.
data_description.archive_model_search_enabled: Expose bounded, current-scope lexical archive search to the model. No extra model calls or embeddings are used.
data_description.voice_scope_policy: How unidentified voice requests are scoped. Do not retain is the privacy-conscious default.
data_description.voice_device_mappings: Map Home Assistant device IDs to user IDs, shared, or unretained.
data_description.continue_conversation: HA Default uses Home Assistant's normal punctuation-based behavior. Always listens again after successful responses. Conditional lets the language model decide when an immediate follow-up is expected.
data_description.context_threshold: Provider-reported input-token count that triggers context management.
data_description.context_truncate_strategy: Keep recent messages is recommended. Clear all preserves legacy behavior. Summarize makes one bounded model request and falls back to keeping recent messages if it fails.

data_description.shorten_tool_call_id: Required for Mistral AI cloud API compatibility. Enable only if your provider requires short (9-character) tool call IDs. Keep disabled for OpenAI and most other providers.
data_description.memory_auto_retrieve_limit: Select up to this many relevant memories when a new conversation starts. The same memories remain available for that conversation. Set to 0 to use memory only on demand.
data_description.memory_retrieval_mode: Use lightweight local lexical ranking or optional embedding-based hybrid semantic retrieval.
data_description.memory_embedding_model: Embedding model used only for hybrid semantic retrieval.
